## Overview
Lokesh Sain is an India-based Software Engineer focusing on production-grade frontend and full-stack engineering. He specializes in React.js, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and integrating Large Language Model (LLM) APIs into web interfaces. He holds a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) with an 8.29/10 CGPA.
